authority_declaration_floor_reason: A stale index is wrong in the direction that matters: it reports a newly-landed declaration as still absent, so an expired claim reads as still-valid. Measured 2026-08-27, the COMMITTED snapshot artifacts/autogenesis/kernel-dependency-projection-v1.json held 1,644 declarations against a live 1,861 -- a 217-declaration gap. This floor is deliberately BELOW the live count and above that gap: it must reject a snapshot that stale without redding every lane whose branch predates today's landings by a handful of declarations. Raise it when the gap it needs to catch grows; lower it only if declarations were genuinely removed.
bare_named_claim_budget_reason: Raised 2026-08-31 (absence-and-orphans lane) from 141 to 249 after hand-auditing the overage, not by --update-budget alone. Method: enumerated all 268 bare sites against a fresh `kernel_declaration_projection`; found and corrected 8 genuinely STALE claims (CReal.uniform_converges_add/Nat.even_or_odd/CReal.alternatingBracketUpper+LowerBound+UpperBound in docs/plan/status/133-ledger-uc.md -- already `was-absent`-annotated elsewhere in the same file but in a separate Markdown block, so the checker never saw the fix; Nat.ascFactorial+Nat.descFactorial in docs/plan/status/200-nat-factorial.md; Nat.clog in docs/plan/status/206-nat-log-tier.md; Rat.ofInt at two sites in complex.rs; CReal.sqrt in nat_prelude/irrational.rs; Nat.gcd_comm in int_prelude/gcd.rs), each corrected in place with a dated note quoting the stale text, per the 08-ivt convention; then annotated 16 more verified-still-absent single-declaration claims (CReal.le_total x3, Rat.ofRat x2, Nat.max/Nat.min, Complex.le/Complex.lt, Nat.factorization, Nat.gcd_zero_right, Nat.gcd_mul_left, Rat.prodRange, Rat.one_mul/Rat.zero_mul, Rat.abs_zero_WRONG, WellFounded.rec-adjacent) with `<!-- absent: ... -->`. That left 249 bare. Sampled the remainder for more stale/annotatable claims across every structural class (all 66 single-candidate blocks; every docs/research/09-decisions/ site; every line-paired candidate) and found ZERO further genuine per-declaration absence claims -- every one is a CENSUS FALSE POSITIVE of DECL_RE/CLAIM_RE's block-granularity matching: the CLAIM_PHRASE ("does not exist", "blocked on", "is absent") fires on one sentence in a multi-paragraph block (a table row, a diary entry, an ADR's landed-declarations list), and DECL_RE then harvests every Root.name in the WHOLE block as a "candidate", most of which are cited as PRESENT evidence or context, not the claim's subject. This is the same failure class the 2026-08-27 absence-adopt lane measured (55/70 rejected as not genuine). A structural fix -- pairing a claim to names on its OWN line/sentence rather than its whole block -- would shrink this budget dramatically and is recommended as follow-up work; this lane did not attempt it (out of scope: a matching-logic change to the checker itself, not a cleanup pass). Lower this budget by annotating a claim (preferred) or run --update-budget to record a further deliberate change, which leaves a visible diff.

excluded_paths.reason: Generated by scripts/gen-plan.py and never hand-edited (CLAUDE.md Session Protocol), so a marker written here is erased by the next regeneration. Its absence claims come from docs/plan/status/*.md and docs/plan/global/*.md, which ARE scanned -- annotate them at the source.
